Guard Tours

Guard Tour Software NFC-powered patrol verification.

Verify guard patrols with tamper-proof NFC checkpoint scanning. Automatic client reports generated after every tour — no manual paperwork.

Book a Free Demo View Pricing

PatrolPilot's guard tour software uses NFC (Near Field Communication) technology to verify guard presence at defined checkpoints during patrol rounds. Every scan is timestamped and geo-tagged, creating an irrefutable audit trail for your clients. Used by security companies across the USA, Canada, UK, UAE and Singapore to eliminate patrol fraud and build client trust.

NFC Checkpoint Scanning

Guards tap their phone against NFC tags installed at checkpoints. Each scan is recorded with a timestamp, GPS location and guard ID — tamper-proof.

Automated Tour Reports

After each patrol round, PatrolPilot automatically generates a detailed tour report with all checkpoint scans, times, guard details and route map.

Missed Checkpoint Alerts

Instant alerts to supervisors if a guard misses a scheduled checkpoint scan. Never let a client wonder if their site was properly patrolled.

Custom Patrol Routes

Define patrol routes with required checkpoints and time windows for each scan. Flexible enough for any site layout or security requirement.

Client Portal Access

Give clients read-only access to their patrol reports. Build trust and reduce client queries with transparent, real-time reporting.

Offline Mode

NFC scans are queued and synced when connectivity is restored. Guards can complete patrols even in underground car parks or low-signal areas.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is NFC guard tour software? +
NFC guard tour software uses Near Field Communication tags placed at checkpoints around a site. Guards scan the tags with their smartphone during patrol rounds, creating a verified, timestamped record of their patrol. This replaces wand-based systems and paper logs.
Are the NFC tags tamper-proof? +
NFC tags themselves are passive and cannot be manipulated. PatrolPilot records the GPS location at the time of each scan, so any attempt to scan from a remote location would be flagged as a location mismatch.
How are tour reports delivered to clients? +
Tour reports can be automatically emailed to clients after each patrol, accessed through the client portal, or downloaded as PDFs on demand. Reports are white-labelled with your company branding.
What happens if the phone has no internet connection during a patrol? +
The PatrolPilot app has a full offline mode. NFC scans, GPS locations and timestamps are stored on the device and automatically synced to the platform when internet connectivity is restored.
